Questions

How do I solve a word search?

Find each word from the list hidden in the grid and circle it. Words run in straight lines. Harder puzzles use bigger grids and longer words.

How hard are the puzzles?

There are three levels: 33 easy, 33 medium, 33 hard.

Are the answers included?

Yes. Full solutions are at the back.
